title: Poe wants proposed AI authority placed under DOST, not DICT

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A lawmaker pushing for a national framework on artificial intelligence (AI) wants a proposed agency overseeing the technology’s development placed under the Department of Science and Technology (DOST), saying the department is better equipped to drive research and innovation than the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT). FPJ Panday Bayanihan Rep.
